description: LIVE: headlines from eight security trade outlets (BleepingComputer, The Hacker News, SecurityWeek, The Record, Krebs on Security, …): headline, outlet, date and link only, never the article text. Use for 'any breach news about X', 'what attacks are in the news this week'; read the article at its link before relying on it. Deterministic: no model in the loop.

query.description: Optional. Words that must all appear in the headline, e.g. 'breach', 'ransomware hospital', 'Okta'.

name: security_headlines
title: Security news headlines (breaches, attacks, exploits)
